CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.KOL_EksportTwr(@TS INT,@NumerPaczki INT,@RozmiarPaczki INT,@OpeNumer INT) AS BEGIN TRAN
DECLARE @lowerRank int DECLARE @upperRank int
SET @lowerRank=@RozmiarPaczki * @NumerPaczki + 1 SET @upperRank=@RozmiarPAczki * (@NumerPaczki+1)
CREATE TABLE #TmpTable (GIDNumer int not null, Typ int not null, Kod varchar(40) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, FPPKod varchar(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Nazwa varchar(255) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Sww varchar(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Ean varchar(40) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Jm varchar(8) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Waga decimal(7,3) not null, LastModC int not null, LP int identity not null, KlasaCechy int not null, cenanetto decimal(15,2) not null, cenabrutto decimal(15,2) not null )
declare @frs varchar(255) declare @frsid int select @frsid=ope_frsid from cdn.opekarty where ope_gidnumer=@OpeNumer set @frs=convert(varchar(10),@frsid) while @frsid<>0 begin select @frsid=frs_gronumer from cdn.frmstruktura where FrS_Id=@frsid set @frs=@frs+','+convert(varchar(10),@frsid) end select @frsid=FRS_CenaDomyslna from cdn.frmstruktura where FrS_Id in (select ope_frsid from cdn.opekarty where ope_gidnumer=@OpeNumer)
INSERT INTO #TmpTable (GIDNumer,Typ,Kod,FPPKod,Nazwa,Sww,Ean,Jm,Waga,LastModC,KlasaCechy,cenanetto,cenabrutto) SELECT Twr_GidNumer, ISNULL(Twr_GidTyp,0), ISNULL(Twr_Kod,''), ISNULL(Twr_FppKod,''), ISNULL(Twr_Nazwa,''), ISNULL(Twr_Sww,''), ISNULL(Twr_Ean,''), ISNULL(Twr_Jm,''), ISNULL(Twr_WagaBrutto,0)*(case twr_wjm when 'Gram' then 0.001 when 'Dkg' then 0.01 when 'Tona' then 1000 else 1 end) , Twr_LastModC, ISNULL(Twr_CCKNumer,0), convert(decimal(15,2),round(isnull((case when substring(a.naz_nazwa,11,1)='N' then twc_wartosc else twc_wartosc/(1+convert(decimal(15,4),rtrim(substring(b.naz_nazwa1,1,2)))/100) end),0),2)) as netto, convert(decimal(15,2),round(isnull((case when substring(a.naz_nazwa,11,1)='B' then twc_wartosc else twc_wartosc*(1+convert(decimal(15,4),rtrim(substring(b.naz_nazwa1,1,2)))/100) end),0),2)) as brutto FROM CDN.TwrKarty left join cdn.twrceny on Twr_GIDNumer=TwC_TwrNumer and twc_twrlp=(case when @OpeNumer=0 then Twr_CenaSpr else (case when CDN.CzyCenaWCentrum(@frs,Twr_CenaSpr)=1 then twr_cenaspr else @frsid end) end) left join cdn.nazwy a on a.naz_gidlp= (case when @OpeNumer=0 then Twr_CenaSpr else twc_twrlp end) and a.naz_gidtyp=64 left join cdn.nazwy b on b.naz_gidtyp=624 and Twr_GrupaPodSpr=substring(b.naz_nazwa,1,1) WHERE Twr_GIDNumer > 0 AND Twr_Aktywna = 0 AND Twr_LastModC > @TS AND twr_archiwalny = 0
DELETE FROM #TmpTable WHERE LP NOT BETWEEN @lowerRank AND @upperRank
SELECT GIDNumer, Typ, Kod, FPPKod, Nazwa, Sww, Ean, Jm, Waga,LastModC, LP, KlasaCechy,cenanetto,cenabrutto FROM #TmpTable ORDER BY LP
SELECT TwJ_TwrNumer, TwJ_TwrLp, TwK_Kod, TwJ_TypJm, TwJ_JmZ, TwJ_PrzeliczL, TwJ_PrzeliczM FROM CDN.TwrJM join CDN.TwrKody on TwK_TwrNumer=TwJ_TwrNumer and TwK_Jm=TwJ_JmZ and TwK_Rodzaj=0 JOIN #TmpTable ON GidNumer = TwJ_TwrNumer WHERE ISNULL(TwK_Kod,'') <> '' AND LastModC > @TS ORDER BY LP
DROP TABLE #TmpTable
COMMIT TRAN
